tool.name: TopAnat
tool.description: GO-like enrichment of anatomical terms and cell types mapped to genes by expression patterns
tool.version_command: echo $(R --version | grep version | grep -v GNU)", BgeeDB version" $(R --vanilla --slave -e "library(BgeeDB); cat(sessionInfo()\$otherPkgs\$BgeeDB\$Version)" 2> /dev/null | grep -v -i "WARNING: ")
tool.command:
Rscript '$__tool_directory__/topanat.R' --species '$species' --resultFile '$result'
#if $dataTypes --dataTypes '$dataTypes' #end if
#if $stageId --stageId '$stageId' #end if
## Foreground genes #if $fg.fg_source == "text" --fgFile '$fg_genes_config' #else --fgFile '$fg.fg_file' #end if
## Background genes #if $bg.bg_source == "text" --bgFile '$bg_genes_config' #elif $bg.bg_source == "file" --bgFile '$bg.bg_file' #end if
## Advanced options --algorithm '$adv.algorithm' --statistics '$adv.statistics' --nodeSize $adv.nodeSize --confidence '$adv.confidence'

param.name: species
param.label: Species
param.help: Species for which the enrichment analysis will be performed. Species and expression data are provided by the Bgee database.

param.name: dataTypes
param.label: Data types
param.help: Expression data types to use when building gene-to-anatomy annotations. If none are selected, all available data types for the species are used.

param.name: stageId
param.label: Developmental stage filter
param.help: Restrict expression data to a specific developmental stage using an ontology term ID (e.g. UBERON:0000092 for post-embryonic stage). If left empty, all developmental stages are used.

validator.message: Please provide a valid ontology term ID (e.g. UBERON:0000092), or leave empty

param.name: fg_source
param.label: Foreground genes input format
param.help: The foreground is the gene set of interest for which anatomical enrichment will be computed. Gene IDs must be Ensembl IDs (e.g. ENSG00000244734) or species-specific IDs as used in Bgee.
param.option: Upload a file (one gene ID per line, no header)

param.name: fg_genes_text
param.label: Foreground gene IDs
param.help: Enter one gene ID per line. Gene IDs must be Ensembl gene IDs (e.g. ENSG00000244734) or species-specific gene IDs as used in Bgee, not gene names (e.g. HBB).

validator.message: At least one foreground gene ID is required

param.name: fg_file
param.label: Foreground genes file
param.help: One-column file with no header, containing one gene ID per line.

param.name: bg_source
param.label: Background genes (universe)
param.help: The background defines the gene universe for the enrichment test. All foreground genes must be present in the background.
param.option: Use all genes with expression data in Bgee (recommended default)
Upload a file (one gene ID per line, no header)

param.name: bg_genes_text
param.label: Background gene IDs
param.help: Enter one gene ID per line. All foreground genes must be included. Gene IDs must be Ensembl IDs or species-specific IDs as used in Bgee, not gene names.

validator.message: At least one background gene ID is required when providing a custom background

param.name: bg_file
param.label: Background genes file
param.help: One-column file with no header, containing one gene ID per line. All foreground genes must be included.

param.name: algorithm
param.label: Decorrelation algorithm
param.help: Algorithm used to account for the topology of the anatomical ontology when computing enrichment. 'classic' ignores topology. See topGO documentation for details on each algorithm.

param.name: statistics
param.label: Test statistic
param.help: Statistical test used to compute enrichment p-values. Fisher's exact test is most commonly used. See topGO documentation for details.

param.name: nodeSize
param.label: Minimum node size
param.help: Minimum number of genes that must be annotated to an anatomical entity for that entity to be tested. Entities with fewer annotated genes are pruned. Default: 10.

param.name: confidence
param.label: Expression call quality
param.help: Minimum quality level for expression calls to be included in the analysis. 'silver' and 'gold' apply to Bgee release 14 and above; 'all' and 'high_quality' apply to older releases.

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
TopAnat performs a GO-like enrichment analysis of anatomical terms and cell types for a given list of genes. It uses active expression calls from the `Bgee`_ database to map genes to the anatomical entities and cell types where they are expressed, then applies a topGO-based enrichment test to identify anatomical entities over-represented in the foreground gene set compared to a background (universe).
This analysis is conceptually similar to a Gene Ontology enrichment analysis, but uses anatomy ontology terms (from `UBERON`_) and cell type terms (from `CL`_) instead of GO terms, with gene annotations derived from curated expression data rather than functional annotation databases.
A typical use case is to identify in which tissues or cell types a set of genes of interest (e.g. differentially expressed genes, genes associated with a disease) are preferentially expressed.
-----
**Inputs**
**Species** The species for which the analysis is performed. Must be provided in the format ``Genus_species`` (e.g. ``Homo_sapiens``, ``Mus_musculus``, ``Danio_rerio``). See the `Bgee website`_ for the full list of supported species.
**Data types** The expression data types used to build gene-to-anatomy annotations. Available options:
- *Bulk RNA-seq*: bulk RNA sequencing data - *Full-length single-cell RNA-seq*: full-length scRNA-seq data (e.g. Smart-seq2) - *Droplet-based single-cell RNA-seq*: droplet-based scRNA-seq data (e.g. 10x Genomics) - *Affymetrix microarray*: Affymetrix microarray data
If none are selected, all available data types for the species are used.
**Developmental stage filter** An optional ontology term ID to restrict expression calls to a specific developmental stage (e.g. ``UBERON:0000092`` for post-embryonic stage). Leave empty to use all stages.
**Foreground genes** The gene set of interest: anatomical entities significantly enriched in this set will be reported. Gene IDs must be **Ensembl IDs** (e.g. ``ENSG00000244734``) or species-specific IDs as stored in Bgee — not gene symbols (e.g. ``HBB``, ``Apoc1``). Can be provided as a pasted list (one ID per line) or as a single-column file with no header.
**Background genes (universe)** The gene universe for the enrichment test. All foreground genes must be present in the background. By default (recommended), all genes with expression data in Bgee for the selected species are used. A custom background can be provided as a pasted list or a file.
-----
**Advanced Options**
**Decorrelation algorithm** Controls how the topology of the anatomy ontology is handled:
- *classic*: each term is tested independently (no decorrelation, fastest) - *elim*: removes genes that are significant in descendant nodes before testing a parent - *weight*: weights genes based on scores of neighboring nodes - *weight01*: binary version of weight - *lea*: local enrichment analysis - *parentchild*: accounts for the parent-child relationships of terms
See `topGO documentation`_ for details.
**Test statistic** Statistical test for computing enrichment p-values. Fisher's exact test is the most commonly used.
**Minimum node size** Anatomical entities annotated to fewer genes than this threshold are excluded from testing. Increasing this value reduces the number of tested terms and improves statistical power for the remaining ones. Default: 10.
**Expression call quality** Minimum quality level for expression calls included in the analysis:
- *silver* (default for Bgee ≥ 14): includes both silver and gold quality calls - *gold* (Bgee ≥ 14): restricts to the highest-quality calls only - *all* (Bgee < 14): includes all calls regardless of quality - *high_quality* (Bgee < 14): restricts to high-quality calls
-----
**Output**
A tab-separated table of anatomical entities tested for enrichment, including:
- Anatomical entity ID and name - Number of annotated genes in the background and foreground - Enrichment FDR and fold enrichment
-----
**References**
.. _Bgee: https://www.bgee.org .. _Bgee website: https://www.bgee.org/search/species .. _TopAnat on Bgee website: https://www.bgee.org/analysis/top-anat .. _topGO documentation: https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/topGO.html .. _UBERON: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/uberon .. _CL: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/cl
